**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **What the document does:** §5.1 contains only a reasonable-care-and-skill Services undertaking plus an authority rep and a compliance-with-laws covenant. There is no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the software portions of the Base Components, no warranty period, and no remedy. §5.2 makes §5.1 the exclusive warranty set, and §5.4 adds "AS IS" and no-error-free-operation disclaimers — so nothing else in the document supplies a warranty remedy (no service credits or re-performance mechanic exists).
- **Why it fails fallback:** all four fallback elements (90-day software conformance, 30-day Services warranty, repair/replacement, refund) are absent.
- **Cure:** one short insert as new §5.1(c)/(d), placed inside §5.1 so the new warranties are inside the §5.2 exclusivity carve-in, with a single repair/replace-or-refund remedy sentence. Preferred-level extras (12-month period, 90-day Services period, malicious code) were deliberately not added, and unrelated text was left untouched.
